result.instructions: Tools for WHOOP, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WHOOP data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run whoop_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run whoop_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run whoop_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. whoop_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: whoop_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: The current user's basic WHOOP profile (user id, email, first name, last name). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/user/profile/basic. Scope: read:profile.

tools.name: whoop_body_measurement
tools.title: Get body measurement
tools.description: The user's body measurements (height in meters, weight in kilograms, max heart rate). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/user/measurement/body. Scope: read:body_measurement.

tools.name: whoop_list_cycles
tools.title: List cycles
tools.description: List the user's physiological cycles (a WHOOP 'day', ~24h anchored to sleep), most recent first. Each cycle carries a score with day strain, kilojoules burned, and average/max heart rate. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/cycle. Scope: read:cycles.

limit.description: Max records to return per page (1–25, default 10).

start.description: Return records created at/after this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

end.description: Return records created before this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-02-01T00:00:00.000Z.

nextToken.description: Pagination cursor: pass the `next_token` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: whoop_get_cycle
tools.title: Get cycle
tools.description: Get a single physiological cycle by its id (strain, kilojoules, average/max heart rate, start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/cycle/{cycleId}. Scope: read:cycles.

cycleId.description: The cycle id (an integer, e.g. from whoop_list_cycles).

tools.name: whoop_get_cycle_recovery
tools.title: Get cycle recovery
tools.description: Get the recovery scored for a specific cycle (recovery %, resting heart rate, HRV RMSSD, SpO2 %, skin temperature). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/cycle/{cycleId}/recovery. Scope: read:recovery.

cycleId.description: The cycle id (an integer, e.g. from whoop_list_cycles).

tools.name: whoop_list_recoveries
tools.title: List recoveries
tools.description: List the user's recoveries, most recent first. Each recovery scores how ready the body is (recovery %, resting heart rate, HRV RMSSD, SpO2 %, skin temperature) and links to its cycle and sleep. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/recovery. Scope: read:recovery.

limit.description: Max records to return per page (1–25, default 10).

start.description: Return records created at/after this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

end.description: Return records created before this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-02-01T00:00:00.000Z.

nextToken.description: Pagination cursor: pass the `next_token` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: whoop_list_sleep
tools.title: List sleep
tools.description: List the user's sleep activities, most recent first. Each carries a score with sleep-stage summary, sleep needed, respiratory rate, and sleep performance %. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/sleep. Scope: read:sleep.

limit.description: Max records to return per page (1–25, default 10).

start.description: Return records created at/after this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

end.description: Return records created before this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-02-01T00:00:00.000Z.

nextToken.description: Pagination cursor: pass the `next_token` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: whoop_get_sleep
tools.title: Get sleep
tools.description: Get a single sleep activity by its id (stage summary, sleep needed, respiratory rate, sleep performance %, start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/sleep/{sleepId}. Scope: read:sleep.

sleepId.description: The sleep id (a UUID, e.g. from whoop_list_sleep).

tools.name: whoop_list_workouts
tools.title: List workouts
tools.description: List the user's workouts, most recent first. Each carries a score with strain, average/max heart rate, distance (meters), and per-heart-rate-zone durations. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/workout. Scope: read:workout.

limit.description: Max records to return per page (1–25, default 10).

start.description: Return records created at/after this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

end.description: Return records created before this ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-02-01T00:00:00.000Z.

tools.name: whoop_get_workout
tools.title: Get workout
tools.description: Get a single workout by its id (sport, strain, average/max heart rate, distance, zone durations, start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/workout/{workoutId}. Scope: read:workout.

workoutId.description: The workout id (a UUID, e.g. from whoop_list_workouts).
